title: Tabula device settings (v4)
description: Single source of truth for per-device settings. HA is authoritative (plan 5.6): the integration validates and stores settings, pushes them with set_settings (docs/PROTOCOL.md 4.5) and the device caches them. This file covers what Phases 1-3 use: identity, connection, screen, screensaver (with the Phase 3 clock, night mode, weather, photos, website, dim, pixel-shift and fade keys), notifications, audio, At a Glance, corner widgets and the schedule, plus the voice and intercom groups of Phase 7 and 9. Every property carries a role tag (x-tabula-role); profiles may manage only 'shared' keys (F-MGT-03, F-MGT-04). No property carries the 'hardware' role yet — codegen must not assume every role in x-tabula-roles has members. Every leaf property names its behavior in x-tabula-feature (a docs/FEATURES.md item ID, or 'independent design' with the ADR). Defaults come only from docs/decisions/0002-constants.md. A key HA does not send keeps the device default (PROTOCOL 4.5); settings.schema.json versions independently of the protocol (schema_version in set_settings).

identity.description: Who the device is. Never shared by profiles (F-MGT-03).

name.description: Display name of the device in HA. Set at pairing or from the settings editor; unique per device. Length bound per ADR 0002 (identifiers and labels). No default: an unset name falls back to the model or device ID.

connection.description: How the device reaches HA. The only keys the recovery paths may change (F-MGT-11); never shared by profiles.

ha_url.description: Base URL of the HA server: http or https scheme, host, optional port and optional path only — no userinfo, query or fragment. Credentials in the URL would be stored, cached and exported with settings, and a query or fragment breaks resolving relative navigate/play_media paths (PROTOCOL 4.5). No default: the device keeps the address it paired with.

screen.description: Panel brightness and power behavior (FEATURES F-SCR). Brightness levels are shared: a profile may carry them, but new profiles start without them (F-MGT-04).

brightness.description: Stored base brightness, percent, applied by the screen light entity (F-SCR-04) and the screen command. Default per ADR 0002.

adaptive_brightness.description: Brightness follows room light through a curve (F-SCR-05). Off until the curve is tuned on real hardware; default per ADR 0002.

keep_screen_on.description: Stop the OS display timeout from turning the panel off while the app is in the foreground (F-SCR-01); the screensaver handles idling. Default per ADR 0002.

dashboard.description: The dashboard's start target and return-after-idle rule (FEATURES F-DSH-02, F-DSH-15). Shared keys.

start_path.description: The page the app opens on launch, after a crash or restart, and on go home: an HA frontend path with a single leading slash, an optional URL fragment, and no query string; empty is HA's default page. A frontend path, not a catalog entry, until the page catalog exists (F-DSH-03, ADR 0021). Bounds per ADR 0002.

return_home_after.description: Seconds without touch before the dashboard returns to its start target; 0 never returns. The timer keeps running behind a screensaver, so a covered panel resets without lighting. Bounds and the never default per ADR 0002.

screensaver.description: Idle screensaver (FEATURES F-SSV): the engine keys and one nested group per mode.

enabled.description: Master switch for the idle screensaver (F-SSV-01). Default per ADR 0002.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without interaction before the screensaver starts (F-SSV-01). Bounds per ADR 0002 (Settings bounds in the settings schema); default per ADR 0002.

mode.description: The screensaver mode used next time it starts (F-SSV-05). Values match the screensaver_mode state key (PROTOCOL 4.4). Default per ADR 0002.

brightness.description: Separate backlight level, percent, while the screensaver shows (F-SSV-17); the previous level returns on dismissal. Dim and black have their own levels (dim_brightness; black is always lowest). Default per ADR 0002.

brightness_enabled.description: Whether the separate screensaver backlight level (brightness) applies (F-SSV-17). Off: the screensaver shows at the panel's current level. Dim and black keep their own levels either way. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

dim_brightness.description: Dim mode's own backlight level, percent (F-SSV-07): the dashboard stays visible at a low level. Dim no longer borrows screensaver.brightness (ADR 0013 item 4). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

clock.description: Clock mode (F-SSV-08, F-SSV-09): face, typography, layout, colors and the optional background image. Fonts name system families only; nothing is bundled in this phase.

face.description: The clock face (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

font_family.description: System font family name (F-SSV-08); the device falls back to its default family when the name does not resolve. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

font_weight.description: Font weight on Android's 100-900 axis (F-SSV-08); 400 is the system's normal. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hour_24.description: 24-hour time when true, 12-hour with the AM/PM marker when false (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

show_seconds.description: Show a seconds display (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

show_am_pm.description: Show the AM/PM marker in 12-hour time (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

show_date.description: Show a date line under the time, in the app language (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

size.description: Clock size, percent of the mode's base size (F-SSV-08). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

text_color.description: Clock text color, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (Android order). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

background_color.description: Solid background color when no background image is set, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

background_source.description: Background image source (F-SSV-09): empty for none, a local file path on the device, or a URL the tablet downloads directly. Every write triggers a fresh load, identical value or not (F-SSV-09). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

background_refresh.description: Seconds between re-fetches of a URL background (F-SSV-09); 0 never re-fetches. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

background_darken.description: Darkening strength, percent, of the readability layer over the background image (F-SSV-09). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

night_mode.description: Clock night mode (F-SSV-10): a dark color scheme below a light threshold, from the tablet's own light sensor only (an HA illuminance entity is never used here).

enabled.description: Night mode is off unless the device has a light sensor and the user opts in (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

light_threshold.description: Below this ambient light, lux, the clock switches to the night scheme (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hysteresis_lux.description: Lux above the threshold the light must rise before night mode ends (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hide_background.description: Hide the background image at night so the scheme's dark background shows (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hide_overlays.description: Hide the corner widgets and the At a Glance row at night (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

power_off_delay.description: Minutes of night mode before the panel powers off, 0 = never (F-SSV-10). The countdown is F-SSV-19's, later phase: until it ships the key no-ops. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

black_screen_alternative.description: Show a plain black screen instead of powering the panel off, for sensors that stop reporting while the panel is off (F-SSV-10). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

weather.description: Weather scene mode (F-SSV-11): an animated sky following one HA weather entity.

entity_id.description: The HA weather entity the scene follows (F-SSV-11); empty shows the mode's pick-an-entity prompt. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

place_name.description: Optional place name in the info bar (F-SSV-11). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

clock_overlay.description: Draw a clock over the scene (F-SSV-11). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

info_bar.description: Draw the weather information bar: temperature, condition, daily high/low, humidity, wind, visibility, apparent temperature (F-SSV-11). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

lightning.description: Lightning effect for storm conditions (F-SSV-11). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

photos.description: Photo slideshow modes (F-SSV-12). media_browser is a source value now so adding its device side (P3.9) needs no schema change.

source.description: Where photos come from (F-SSV-12): a folder on the device, photos picked with the system picker, a single image URL, or HA's media browser. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

folder_path.description: Device folder for the folder source (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

image_url.description: The single image URL for the URL source (F-SSV-12), fetched fresh for each slide; the previous photo stays until the next loads. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

slide_interval.description: Seconds each photo shows (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

transition.description: Transition between slides (F-SSV-12): none, crossfade, slide, zoom, slow pan-and-zoom (stills only), or random per slide. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

fit.description: How a photo fits the panel (F-SSV-12): letterbox, smart fill (crop a little when shapes nearly match, else fill the bars with a blurred, darkened enlargement), or always fill. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

shuffle.description: Shuffle the playlist for folder sources (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

include_subfolders.description: Include subfolders for folder sources (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

edge_taps.description: Edge zones: tapping near a side edge steps one slide and restarts the interval; a tap elsewhere dismisses (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

exif_details.description: Photo details overlay from EXIF: date taken, camera details; no location lookup (F-SSV-12). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

website.description: Website mode (F-SSV-13, F-SSV-14): a full-screen web view of any URL.

url.description: The page to show (F-SSV-13); empty leaves the mode without content. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

zoom.description: Zoom level, percent, of the website view (F-SSV-13). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

double_tap_dismiss.description: Require a double tap to dismiss so single taps reach the page (F-SSV-14). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

pixel_shift.description: Pixel shift (F-SSV-22): periodic small shifts of screensaver content to avoid image retention. Not applied in black mode.

enabled.description: Shift screensaver content periodically (F-SSV-22). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

interval.description: Seconds between shifts (F-SSV-22). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

amplitude.description: Shift distance, pixels (F-SSV-22). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

fade.description: Fade in and out (F-SSV-23). Modes that show the live page itself (dim, HA dashboard view) and web content switch without a fade.

enabled.description: Fade the screensaver in and out (F-SSV-23). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

notifications.description: Defaults for on-screen notification cards (FEATURES F-NTF). Per-card fields override these (F-NTF-01).

default_duration.description: Card lifetime in seconds when the notify command sends no duration; 0 means until dismissed. Bounds match the notify command's duration (ADR 0002); default per ADR 0002.

default_level.description: Severity used when a card's level is missing or unknown (F-NTF-02). Values match the notify command's level (PROTOCOL 4.5). Default per ADR 0002.

chime_by_level.description: Whether a card chimes, per severity (F-NTF-09): sound only for what needs attention. Defaults per ADR 0002: chime for warning and error, silent otherwise.

max_visible.description: Cards shown at once; overflow evicts the oldest (F-NTF-07). Bounds per ADR 0002 (Settings bounds in the settings schema); default per ADR 0002.

audio.description: Volume levels (FEATURES F-TTS). Volume levels are shared: a profile may carry them, but new profiles start without them (F-MGT-04).

media_volume.description: Media channel volume, percent; the level the HA media_player controls (F-TTS-07). Default per ADR 0002.

chime_volume.description: Notification chime loudness, percent of the media volume: the chime plays on the media stream, so the OS silent mode does not mute it, and 100 matches the media volume (F-NTF-09, ADR 0027). Default per ADR 0002.

announce_volume_boost.description: Announcements play at the current volume; no hidden volume jumps. 'none' is the only v1 value (ADR 0002); a boost level, if ever designed, is added with its own ADR and bumps nothing else.

voice.description: Microphone behavior (ADR 0030). Off by default: a kiosk whose microphone is always open is a different product from one that is not, so a household opts in per device.

wake_word_enabled.description: Run on-device wake-word detection while the foreground service is up and RECORD_AUDIO is granted. Detection is suspended while the device plays (ADR 0029 item 3). Default per ADR 0002.

intercom.description: Intercom auto-answer (ADR 0025 decision 1, ADR 0028 guard 1). Off by default: answering opens a microphone with no tap, so a household opts in per device and only for callers it names. A ring always plays a short tone on the communication stream before the microphone opens.

auto_answer.description: Which calls this device answers without a tap: none, only the devices in auto_answer_from, or every Tabula device on the hub. A device without a usable microphone never answers automatically; it still rings. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v4).

auto_answer_from.description: The Tabula device ids this device auto-answers when auto_answer is 'listed' (the ids a ring carries as caller_device_id; PROTOCOL 4.5). Empty with 'listed' answers nobody, which is the fail-safe reading. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v4).

at_a_glance.description: At a Glance (F-AAG-01, F-AAG-02): a row of a few HA entity states drawn on the screensaver, in user-defined order.

entities.description: The entities in the row, in display order (F-AAG-01); the bound is per ADR 0002 (settings v2). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

style.description: Contrasting pill per entity, or plain floating text (F-AAG-02). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hide_names.description: Hide entity names for larger values (F-AAG-02). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

monochrome_icons.description: Render icons in one color instead of HA's state colors (F-AAG-02). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

scale.description: Row scale, percent (F-AAG-02). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

font.description: System font family for the row (F-AAG-02). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

widgets.description: Corner widgets (F-WGT-01): overlays anchored to the four screen corners, at most one per corner, each individually disabled without losing its corner.

shown.description: Global switch: hide or show all widgets (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

scale.description: Global widget scale, percent (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

font.description: Global system font family (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

vignette.description: Dark vignette strength, percent, behind widgets for legibility (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

small_clock.description: Small clock widget (F-WGT-03): time with optional date; never shown over the clock mode.

enabled.description: Show this widget (F-WGT-01); a disabled widget keeps its corner. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

corner.description: The corner this widget anchors to (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

show_date.description: Show the date under the time (F-WGT-03). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

hour_24.description: 24-hour time when true, 12-hour when false (F-WGT-03). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

color.description: Text color, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (F-WGT-03). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

weather.description: Weather widget (F-WGT-04): from an HA weather entity; hidden until an entity is chosen.

enabled.description: Show this widget (F-WGT-01); a disabled widget keeps its corner. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

corner.description: The corner this widget anchors to (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

entity_id.description: The HA weather entity (F-WGT-04); empty hides the widget. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

place_name.description: Optional place name line (F-WGT-04). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

forecast.description: Forecast widget (F-WGT-05): one row per day from an HA weather entity's daily forecast.

enabled.description: Show this widget (F-WGT-01); a disabled widget keeps its corner. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

corner.description: The corner this widget anchors to (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

entity_id.description: The HA weather entity whose daily forecast is shown (F-WGT-05); the widget shows nothing without a daily forecast. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

days.description: How many days to show (F-WGT-05). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

include_today.description: Include today's forecast (F-WGT-05). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

battery.description: Battery widget (F-WGT-06): from the device directly (works offline); hidden on devices without a battery.

enabled.description: Show this widget (F-WGT-01); a disabled widget keeps its corner. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

corner.description: The corner this widget anchors to (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

show_percent.description: Show the battery percentage (F-WGT-06). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

only_when_low.description: Show only when the battery is low; hidden while charging (F-WGT-06). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

entity.description: Entity widget (F-WGT-09): one HA entity's icon and value.

enabled.description: Show this widget (F-WGT-01); a disabled widget keeps its corner. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

corner.description: The corner this widget anchors to (F-WGT-01). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

entity_id.description: The entity shown (F-WGT-09); empty hides the widget. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

attribute.description: Show this attribute's value instead of the state (F-WGT-09); empty means the state. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

name.description: Custom name for the widget (F-WGT-09); empty uses the entity's name. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

visible_values.description: Show the widget only for these values, case-insensitive, matching the displayed or raw value (F-WGT-09); empty shows always. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

schedule.description: Screensaver schedule (F-SSV-18): daily time slots; a slot lasts until the next starts and the last wraps past midnight. A slot's overrides can only turn off overlays that are configured globally, never invent them.

enabled.description: Turn the schedule on or off (F-SSV-18). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

start.description: Local start time, HH:MM 24-hour (F-SSV-18). Required: a slot without a start is meaningless.

mode.description: The mode this slot starts (F-SSV-18); same values as screensaver.mode. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

brightness.description: Fixed backlight level for this slot, percent; null inherits the global value (F-SSV-18). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

power_off_delay.description: Panel power-off delay for this slot, minutes, 0 = never; null inherits the global value (F-SSV-18). Carried now; the countdown is F-SSV-19's and the key no-ops until it ships. Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

presence_dismiss.description: Presence-sensor dismissal for this slot; null inherits the global value (F-SSV-18). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

widgets.description: Corner widgets during this slot; null inherits the global value (F-SSV-18). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

at_a_glance.description: At a Glance row during this slot; null inherits the global value (F-SSV-18). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).

slots.description: The schedule's slots in start-time order (F-SSV-18); the bound is per ADR 0002 (settings v2). Default per ADR 0002 (settings v2).
